message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate criminal charge(s) for the described facts.

Facts: A public servant (尹某) who was a director-level staff (主任科员) and party committee member in the land resources bureau. He used his position to accept bribes (cash and shopping cards) from a company representative (王某某) in exchange for favorable treatment in land project bidding, contracting, etc. Total amount: 13.9万元 (139,000 yuan). He also facilitated a fake invoice for 8万元 (80,000) and accepted cash. He also had some money returned (109,000) after being caught.

Thus the crime is "受贿" (accepting bribes) for a public official. Possibly also "滥用职权" if he abused authority, but the main is "受贿". The description: "利用职务之便，为他人谋取利益，非法收受他人现金计13.9万元据为己有". That's classic "受贿罪". Also "行贿" is for the other party, not relevant.

Thus the answer: [罪名]受贿<eoa>

Check if any other charges: He also gave a false invoice? He gave an invoice to the other party to help them? Actually he gave a false invoice to the other party to get them to pay? The description: "以去北京看病花销多为借口，给王某某提供8万元的发票让王想办法解决". That could be "行贿" by him? No, he gave an invoice to the other party, but the other party gave him cash. That is still bribery. No other crimes like "滥用职权" maybe but the main is "受贿". The typical charge for a public official who accepts bribes is "受贿罪". So answer: 受贿.

Thus JSON: {"reasoning":"...","final_answer":"受贿"}
